themes.label: Strategic dependence threatening sovereignty
themes.definition: Dependence on others in strategic sectors including AI is framed as a threat to the free exercise of sovereignty, requiring rethinking of value chains.
themes.inclusion: Include passages treating reliance on foreign AI or digital supply chains as a sovereignty or strategic-autonomy risk.
themes.exclusion: Exclude general access-gap concerns without a dependence framing.
themes.boundary_cases: When AI is one of several strategic sectors (health, food) in a dependence argument, still code here rather than AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION.

examples.quote: dependence on such strategic sectors as health, digital technology, artificial intelligence as well as food can call into question the free exercise of sovereignty

value.rationale: France's passage places AI among strategic sectors where dependence exposed by the pandemic threatens sovereignty, while arguing for cooperative 'just dependencies' rather than full reshoring.
